about.label: 01 / ABOUT ME
about.principle4: Together, they shape how I solve problems.
about.title: A teacher who loves technology.
about.paragraph1: My professional journey starts in the classroom, where communication, patience and problem-solving are part of everyday life. Outside the classroom, I explore software development and cybersecurity.
about.paragraph2: Teaching has changed the way I approach programming: instead of only asking whether something works, I also ask whether it is understandable, accessible and useful to the person using it.
about.teachText: I enjoy breaking difficult ideas into simple, understandable concepts.
about.buildText: I turn ideas into practical web and mobile applications.
about.secureText: I continuously study ethical hacking and defensive security.
about.mentorText: Teaching helps me communicate, collaborate and guide others.
